note.en: ezTravel is a Taiwan travel agency and app; availability outside Taiwan was not checked.

label.zh-TW: App Store：易遊網（開發者網站為 eztravel.com.tw）
label.en: App Store: ezTravel (developer website on eztravel.com.tw)

title.zh-TW: 透過邀請連結，享 APP 首購優惠
title.en: APP first-purchase offer through the invite link

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案，金額未說明；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; no amount stated. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

title.zh-TW: 完成首單，升等黃金會員
title.en: Gold member upgrade after the first order

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；升等條件與等級名稱未查證，以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; conditions and tier name were not verified. Official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（沒有另外的邀請碼，直接開啟即可）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (there is no separate code; just open it).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示，以 Email 或社群帳號註冊易遊網會員。
steps.en: Register as an ezTravel member with an email or social account, as the page directs.

steps.zh-TW: 完成第一筆訂單；APP 首購優惠與升等條件，以 APP 與官方公告為準。
steps.en: Place your first order; the APP first-purchase offer and the upgrade conditions follow the APP and official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請連結註冊，依分享文案可享 APP 首購優惠，完成首單即升等黃金會員。
intro.en: Per the share text: an APP first-purchase offer and a gold-member upgrade after the first order.

description.zh-TW:
易遊網（ezTravel）是台灣的線上旅遊平台，提供機票、訂房與旅遊商品，有網站與 App。本頁連結是它的會員邀請頁。

依分享文案，點選邀請連結的人可享 APP 首購優惠，完成首單即升等黃金會員，金額與條件沒有說明。邀請頁只有註冊表單，沒有顯示優惠內容。實際內容以易遊網官方公告為準。
description.en:
ezTravel (易遊網) is an online travel platform in Taiwan offering flights, hotels and travel products, on its website and in an app. The link on this page is its member invite page.

Per the share text, a person who opens the invite link gets an APP first-purchase offer and is upgraded to gold member after completing the first order; no amount or conditions are stated. The invite page showed only a sign-up form and no offer text. Actual terms follow ezTravel's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 這是邀請人專屬的邀請連結（分享文案稱「我的邀請連結」，來自平台的分享功能），原樣保留，沒有另外的邀請碼。2026-10-24 維運者開啟連結，是 member.eztravel.com.tw 的會員註冊表單（Email 或社群帳號），沒有顯示優惠內容。APP 首購優惠與升等黃金會員只取自分享文案，金額、條件與等級名稱未查證，官方頁面對會員等級名稱的說法也不一致。註冊時邀請關係與優惠是否生效，沒有測試。沒有找到邀請人可得的回饋，不列出。
notes.en: This is the referrer's personal invite link (the share text calls it “my invite link” and it comes from the platform's share function), kept exactly as shared; there is no separate invite code. On 2026-10-24 the maintainer opened it: a member sign-up form on member.eztravel.com.tw (email or social account) with no offer text. The APP first-purchase offer and the gold-member upgrade come only from the share text; amounts, conditions and tier names were not verified, and official pages name member tiers inconsistently. Whether the referral and offer apply at sign-up was not tested. No reward for the referrer was found, so none is listed.

q.zh-TW: 易遊網的邀請連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need to enter an invite code for the ezTravel invite link?

a.zh-TW: 不需要。分享文案只有連結，沒有邀請碼；網址最後的 GVLSGA7 是連結的一部分，本站沒找到官方稱它為邀請碼的說明。2026-10-24 維運者開啟的邀請頁只有註冊表單。請直接透過本頁連結註冊。
a.en: No. The share text has only a link and no code; GVLSGA7 at the end of the address is part of the link, and no official page calling it an invite code was found. The invite page the maintainer opened on 2026-10-24 showed only a sign-up form. Just sign up through the link on this page.
